solutions.title: Value stack plus minimum stack
solutions.strategy: Keep a normal value stack and push a value onto a second stack whenever it becomes the active minimum.

timeComplexity.explanation: push, pop, top, and getMin each perform a constant number of stack operations.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The value stack stores n values and the minimum stack can also store up to n values.

solutions.title: Encoded minimum in one stack
solutions.strategy: Store an encoded marker when a pushed value becomes the new minimum so the previous minimum can be restored on pop.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each public operation does constant arithmetic and stack access.

spaceComplexity.explanation: A single stack stores one raw or encoded value for each active pushed value.
